name: fitmyoutfit
description: Custom apparel design platform: Medusa backend, Next.js storefront and 3D editor.

scripts.quickstart: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint:scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:scripts
scripts.lint:scripts: node --check scripts/setup.mjs && node --check scripts/dev.mjs && node --check scripts/install-backend.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/env-file.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/env-file.test.mjs
